name: Story Builder
description: Everyone contributes a sentence, AI weaves them into a story, teacher previews before sharing.

collect.prompt: Write one interesting sentence that could be part of a story.

process.instruction: Using the sentences below as inspiration, weave them into a short, creative story (3-5 paragraphs). Try to incorporate ideas from every response. Make it fun and engaging for a classroom.

end.message: Thanks for building a story together!

recommendedFor: Teacher previews the AI-woven story before showing — good safety net for younger classes.
